(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising: obtaining a request for data from a client computer; accessing a first server computer from a second server computer over a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; circuitry for accessing the first server computer from the second server computer over a path in a computer network including one or more server computers; circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The computer program product of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: program instructions for obtaining a request for data from a client computer; program instructions for accessing a first server computer from a second server computer over a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; program instructions for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and program instructions for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.
